headlines.title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (ENXTAM:CCEP) Stock Could Be 37% Undervalued On Cash Flow
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners has delivered a strong multi year share price run, and that raises a straightforward question for you as an investor. Is the current market value of the stock supported by the cash it is expected to generate? Over the past 5 years the share price has gained 118.3%, which puts real weight on whether the underlying cash flows can carry that kind of move.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola Europacific Beats First-Half Forecasts Despite Premarket Share Decline
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners PLC (NASDAQ:CCEP) delivered first-half 2026 results ahead of market expectations, driven by higher sales volumes and favourable pricing across its European and Asia-Pacific operations. Despite the earnings beat, the company’s shares fell 3.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners posts higher first-half profit
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, one of the world's largest Coca-Cola bottlers, on Tuesday reported higher first-half profit, driven by revenue growth, and reaffirmed its full-year outlook. For fiscal 2026, the UK-based company continues to expect comparable, foreign exchange-neutral operating profit growth of around 7% and revenue growth of 3% to 4% year-on-year.

headlines.title: This Dividend Stock Yielding More Than 4x the Nasdaq-100 Looks Like a Buy Right Now
headlines.summary: One of the "other" Coke stocks, Coca-Cola Europacific Partners, may be an underappreciated dividend name.

headlines.title: Diageo Picks WPP’s Wilson to Succeed Finance Chief Jhangiani
headlines.summary: The spirits company named Wilson to succeed Nik Jhangiani—who was also interim CEO last year—at some point in 2027.

description: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners PLC, together with its subsidiaries, produces, distributes, and sells a range of non-alcoholic ready-to-drink beverages. It offers flavours, mixers, energy drinks, soft drinks, water, enhanced water, isotonic drinks, tea and coffee, juices, and other drinks. The company provides its products under the Coca-Cola Original Taste, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Diet Coke, Sprite, Sprite Zero Sugar, Fanta, Fanta Zero Sugar, Monster Energy, A&W, Absolut Vodka & SPRITE, Ades, Appletiser, aquaBona, Aquarius, BACARDÍ Mixed with Coca Cola RTD, Barista Bros, Bonaqua, BURN, Deep Spring, Dr Pepper, Dr Pepper Zero Sugar, Feral Brewing Co, Fuze Tea, Giancarlo Coffee, GLACEAU smartwater, Grinders, HALO, Jack Daniel's & Coca-Cola ready-to-drink, Kristal, L&P, MER, Minute Maid, Mother, Mount Franklin, Nordic Mist, Nutriboost, Oasis, Pulpy, pump, pumped, Reign, Rekorderlig Cider, Relentless, Royal, Royal Bliss, Schweppes, Schweppes Mix, SOCO, URGE, Vilas del Turbón, Voyage, Wilkins Pure, and Zephyr Coffee Co brands. It is also involved in the bottling and other operations. The company was formerly known as Coca-Cola European Partners plc and changed its name to Coca-Cola Europacific Partners PLC in May 2021. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Uxbridge, United Kingdom.
